fusions.name: Spore Bloom
fusions.desc: Bursts a cloud that deals 10 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Rot Harvest
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 20 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It only strikes a target at or below 30% of its health, and uses up every affliction on it for 60% more damage each.

fusions.name: Creeping Mat
fusions.desc: Raises a mat of mould where you stand. For 12 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Slow Contagion
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you regain 2 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
